description:
Make the most of your nursery space with the West Lake Chest. This tall, graceful storage piece offers generous drawer space in a vertical footprint that fits beautifully in any room.

Dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides keep clothing and accessories organized and accessible. Solid hardwood construction with a warm Brown Maple finish ensures lasting beauty. Coordinates with the full West Lake collection.

Non-toxic baby-safe finish.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
